prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Select Your Pet Companion Journey", "body": "Choose quick adoption or create a custom pet from your own photos."}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_adoption_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_adoption_preview": {"headline": "Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "body": "We are assembling your pet's desktop assets.", "layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Log in with your existing account to ensure your pet data and progress are saved."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Setting Up Your Pet", "body": "Your pet will appear on your desktop shortly.", "notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm", "action": "open_tip"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your primary account to automatically sync and restore saved pets."}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload clear, well-lit photos with centered subjects for best rendering."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Completion Progress Notification: Enable visual progress tracking and finish notifications on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Generating Desktop Pet Assets"}}
7: [finish, layout] Home Intro Controls Overview Split Layout: Switch the home intro screen layout to split view detailing taskbar tray management.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready", "body": "Access pet controls anytime from your system tray or taskbar icon."}}
8: [finish, copy] Home Intro System Tray Instructions Copy: Update home intro screen copy with step-by-step instructions for interacting with desktop pets.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Pet Installed Successfully", "body": "Click the taskbar pet icon to open controls, toggle desktop visibility, or talk to your pet."}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Path Overview Copy Update: Revise story screen text to set clear expectations between standard pets and custom photo pets.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how desktop pets work and choose between pre-made companions or custom creations."}}

Adds framing and lighting advice to the photo upload screen without altering steps or pricing.
Enables progress tracking and notifications on the waiting screen while maintaining its job.
Changes home intro screen layout to split view detailing taskbar tray controls within allowed onboarding modifications.
Updates copy on the home intro screen providing clear controls instructions without violating rules.
